# DoodlebookOS Media Assets

This directory stores the official screenshots and video clips used in the repository `README.md` and promotional releases.

### Recommended Media Files (16:9 Aspect Ratio):

- `screenshot_01_desktop.png` — Clean desktop with top bar, bottom shelf dock, clock, and weather widgets.
- `screenshot_02_launcher.png` — Full-screen Material You application launcher with search.
- `screenshot_03_icon_studio.png` — Open Icon Studio tool showing application & PWA icon customization.
- `screenshot_04_installer.png` — OOBE Setup Wizard graphical installer.
- `screenshot_05_light_mode.png` *(Optional)* — Desktop showcasing the Light theme with adaptive contrast.
- `01_quicksettings_drawer.mp4` — Short clip demonstrating smooth opening of the Quick Settings drawer and tile interactions.
- `02_clipboard_meta_v.mp4` — Short clip demonstrating the Material 3 masonry clipboard popup (`Meta+V`).
